findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:1090-1124 labels §8.1 as the deterministic executable-code table but omits PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED. The real read-only observe path returns {status:fail, blocking:false, codes:[PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED]} when pre-review-check.json is absent, as reproduced with `node bin/lattice.js pre_review_check_read {storyId:B-4ec1,json:true}` and implemented at packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:181-186. Add the stable code and its missing/invalid/signature/binding condition so the authoritative plan explains the actual observe diagnostic.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed docs/code drift: execution plan now distinguishes missing artifact from present-invalid PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED and documents the canonical code; current full pre-review smoke and live proof pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts:145-161 / :187-198 — VI-W3-M1-EVERY-BINDING-TAMPER and VI-W3-M4-STABLE-GATE-CODES lack an end-to-end lifecycle-consumer assertion for artifact tamper. The table mutates every binding and proves only pre_review_check_read reports PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED; runPreReviewCheckGate is exercised only for a clean PASS and an enforce failure caused by PR_TOPOLOGY_CRITIC_REATTESTATION_REQUIRED. Therefore the focused smoke can pass even if the actual DEV→REVIEW consumer drops, masks, or fails to block PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED. Add an enforce-mode case with critic precondition satisfied, persist one tampered signed artifact, invoke the real transition gate/entrypoint, assert blocking output contains PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED and no phase/partial metadata write occurs, then restore/reissue exactly and assert the same transition path immediately passes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed lifecycle tamper coverage: full pre-review smoke exercises present-artifact tamper through the real DEV-to-REVIEW lifecycle consumer, rejects partial write, restores, and passes; current canonical pre_review_check is PASS.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:180-185 missing artifact is misclassified as cryptographic/content tampering: verifyPreReviewCheckArtifact returns PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED when artifact is null. The live B-4ec1 DEV-to-REVIEW run had no .lattice/story/actives/B-4ec1/pre-review-check.json and emitted mode=observe status=fail code=PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED, so production audit output cannot distinguish an unrun producer from an altered signed artifact, and the real transition did not prove the promised self-hosted PASS path. Observe being non-blocking is expected rollout behavior but does not make the false failure classification or absent live artifact acceptable. Add a deterministic missing-artifact result/remediation and a live production DEV-to-REVIEW assertion that persists and consumes the verifier-owned artifact; retain PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED only for invalid stored artifacts.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed classification: missing artifact and present-invalid artifact are distinct deterministic paths; full smoke verifies missing/reissue and tampered rejection; current canonical artifact verifies PASS.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:1090-1124 omits PR_TOPOLOGY_CRITIC_REATTESTATION_REQUIRED from its deterministic code table even though packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:153 emits it whenever enforce mode lacks a current independent critic and the lifecycle remediation explicitly promises that stable blocking reason. Add this separate enforce-only condition so §8.1, §8.2 and the actual gate vocabulary agree.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed docs/code drift: execution plan and CLI document PR_TOPOLOGY_CRITIC_REATTESTATION_REQUIRED and enforce-only fresh independent critic semantics; critic smoke passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:103 authority-bypass: the gate treats raw verificationEvidence.attestation.checkedClaims plus two unequal actorTrust strings as admissible authority (lines 121-125), with no signed issuer/receipt verification. The focused test proves PASS only by writing those fields directly through StoryStore at packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts:111-121; the registered evidence CLI schema does not produce them. Therefore an owner-writable checklist can self-assert production-path/mutation/authority/cutoff, while normal production evidence cannot reach the demonstrated PASS path. Replace this with accepted signed receipt/issuer verification and exercise it through the real registered producer.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed authority bypass: raw checklist checkedClaims/actorTrust no longer confer authority; registered live-smoke transcript plus verifier-owned causal receipt is required; bypass mutations bite and canonical authority=admissible.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-coverage-basis.ts:292 planned-actual-bypass: reconciliation declares exact actualPathRefs=[plannedPathRef] whenever each file merely contains the expected symbol text (lines 294-305). A comment, string literal, dead declaration, or wrong producer-consumer relationship therefore satisfies plannedActual=complete without any discovered actual path, contradicting current-worktree discovery/reconciliation and allowing enforce admission on a nonexistent chain. Reconcile against canonical adapter-discovered endpoint/path records and bind those actual refs, with a comment/string mutation that must fail.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed planned/actual bypass: AST-backed exact endpoint discovery and reconciliation replace substring/self-reference checks; missing/ambiguous/cycle and unmapped-path mutations fail closed; plannedActual=complete on current worktree.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:99 mutation-cardinality-bypass: required intent coverage is reduced to presence of any current evidenceRef, while all production/mutation/control/transcript claims are unioned globally (lines 103-118 and 145-152). One hand-authored transcript whose expectedCode equals observedCode can mark mutation-applied/mutation-bites/control-restored for every required binding and mutation, without target/command/polarity proof; one producer-before-consumer pair similarly satisfies transcriptRelated globally. Verify evidence per topology assertion/mutation/consumer edge and require signed command outcome, target, expected stable code, and post-restore control for each required case.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed cardinality bypass: positive, mutation, and transcript evidence are checked per binding with exact cardinality/relation; 17 targeted mutations bite, no-op/wrong polarity fail, and transcript is related.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: .lattice/story/actives/B-4ec1/plan.md:5 promises topology-only omission prints `Pre-review check: FAIL code=AT_UNMAPPED_SCOPE_REF`, but packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:140-141 translates that topology diagnostic to PR_NEW_PATH_UNMAPPED and also adds PR_COVERAGE_BASIS_CHANGED; packages/main/src/handlers/proofstory.ts:514 prints only the first sorted PR_* code. Align the PLAN/user-visible promise with the canonical pre-review vocabulary (and exact first-code ordering), or change implementation/output if AT_UNMAPPED_SCOPE_REF is intentionally the promised surface.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed PLAN/document promise: canonical topology omission first code is PR_NEW_PATH_UNMAPPED with supporting coverage diagnostics; plan review passed and current topology/pre-review basis is complete.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts:71-92,331 and packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:141-159 — live-proof authority remains a hard-coded self-host bypass. The only accepted command runs a temp B-pre-review-smoke fixture, then constructs storyProof for literal storyId B-4ec1 and mechanically marks all 17 current mutation IDs as expectedCode===observedCode with controlRestored=true before printing it; those 17 B-4ec1 mutations are not executed. loadVerifiedPreReviewExecutableProof treats the captured argv/receipt plus that unverified JSON as authoritative bindingProofs. Therefore B-4ec1 can PASS from fabricated per-mutation outcomes, while any other Story using the same production command receives storyId B-4ec1 and cannot obtain a proof at all. Exact argv capture proves the command ran, not that its emitted claims are true; this leaves F-005/F-007 semantically unresolved and makes Wave 3 non-general. Replace the hard-coded storyProof with verifier-derived results from the active Story and bind each assertion/mutation/transcript to actual command outcome artifacts; add a second non-B-4ec1 live Story proving the generic path and a mutation that changes an observed outcome without changing IDs.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed active-story proof authority: live-smoke injects current story identity, producer reads the real contract/checklist, executes per-binding mutations and restoration, and emits a canonical aggregate root over all case records; non-B story and changed-outcome tests pass.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:820-823 and 845-850 say existing refs resolve now and PLAN uses current registered facts, but packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:20-27 plus packages/main/src/core/acceptance-coverage-basis.ts:526-530 intentionally defer pre_review_check, pre_review_check_read, and artifact:pre-review-check.json until the pre_review basis. Document the explicit phase-activation exception and its closed allowlist/fail-closed boundary; otherwise topology authors and auditors are told the opposite of the production PLAN gate.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed decision docs: the closed deferred pre-review control-fact allowlist and PLAN-deferred/PRE_REVIEW-exact semantics are now explicit.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:820-827 and 854-857 require existing source refs to resolve now and occur in the current basis, reserving future paths for verificationIntent-owned planned refs. Production reconciliation at packages/main/src/core/acceptance-coverage-basis.ts:520-524 instead accepts any syntactically valid `basis-path:path:...->...` in an existing source-ref position as a PLAN next-phase forward declaration, while only pre_review rejects a nonexistent path. Document this bounded phase-aware basis-path exception, its allowed positions, and mandatory pre_review resolution (or remove the exception); the current decision contract contradicts the gate.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed decision docs: strict basis-path forward declarations are documented as a bounded PLAN-only exception in command/producer/consumer positions with PRE_REVIEW exact reconciliation and no Wave3A/4 expansion.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts:87 authority/cardinality bypass remains: the only globally accepted proof command is hard-coded in packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:26 to run this smoke with --live-proof, and this smoke constructs storyProof with literal storyId B-4ec1 plus generated A-MUT-1..17 claims (lines 87-92) and emits it at line 230. Those 17 expectedCode===observedCode rows are not the outcomes of 17 executed Story mutations; the command receipt only proves the hard-coded emitter ran. Other stories also receive a proof for B-4ec1 and cannot pass. A canonical runner must derive the current story/bindings and capture each actual mutation command/result/control, not bless hard-coded IDs by overwriting producer/verifier strings in loadVerifiedPreReviewExecutableProof.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed hardcoded proof bypass: B-4ec1/17 hardcoding removed; current captured proof contains one aggregate case root and actual observed/restored results, loader binds root+exact stdout+receipt, and tampered outcomes bite.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:1248 planned/actual semantic bypass remains: sourceExactSymbolCount accepts any exactly-once interface, type alias, enum, variable, property, or method with the expected text, regardless of endpoint.expectedArtifactKind, export/registration/reachability, or producer-to-consumer relation; actualEndpointPathRefs then certifies that as the actual endpoint at lines 1267-1279. Replacing a consumer function with an unused type/const can therefore preserve exact reconciliation. Validate the declared artifact kind and bind a discovered P-to-C edge/call/fact relation, with type-only/dead-symbol/wrong-relation mutations.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed planned/actual resolution: artifact-kind-aware resolver only accepts registered handlers/process facts or exported callables with runtime reachability and producer-consumer relation; type/interface/enum/property/dead/unreachable/duplicate mutations fail.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:293 the advertised strict basis-path validator accepts every trimmed control-free string matching path:.+->.+; e.g. the shipped function returns true for basis-path:path:bogus:x->y. packages/main/src/core/acceptance-coverage-basis.ts:521-524 then permits that nonexistent arbitrary path during PLAN as a forward declaration. PRE_REVIEW later rejects it, but PLAN structural admission is falsely green and recreates the late-block/review-loop problem. Parse and whitelist canonical path classes/endpoint grammar and add an unknown path-kind PLAN mutation.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed path grammar: only canonical process-fact, runtime-fact, and static-call forms pass strict validation; bogus/malformed refs fail and PRE_REVIEW requires exact basis membership.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts:71-92,214-230,331 and packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:115-160 — current evidence for VI-W3-M3-REAL-PROOF-CHAIN, VI-W3-M3-MUTATION-POLARITY-RESTORE, VI-W3-M3-BYPASS-CAMPAIGN and VI-W3-M4-STABLE-GATE-CODES is not valid executable proof. The sole canonical live-proof command emits a literal B-4ec1 proof whose 17 mutation rows are generated as expectedCode===observedCode/controlRestored=true without executing those Story mutations; loadVerifiedPreReviewExecutableProof verifies argv/receipt then upgrades the emitted bindingProofs to trusted producer/verifier authority. The focused smoke therefore PASSes while fabricated mutation outcomes remain admissible, and another Story cannot receive a matching proof. Replace this with active-Story-derived command/result/control artifacts, prove a second non-B-4ec1 Story through the same production path, and add a mutation that changes an observed result while IDs remain unchanged; evidence for the affected must intents must be rerun, not merely rebound.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed coverage authority: current Story live proof actually executes 17 topology mutations and clean controls, records canonical case aggregate, and current canonical pre_review_check PASS shows mutations=biting/transcript=related/authority=admissible.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/pre-review-live-proof.ts:45-72 — the active-story runner is generic in storyId, but it still does not execute the Story executable proof cases promised by Wave 3. Every mutationCaseRef is reduced to the same metadata mutation (replace its sourceRef with unknown:mutation:...), so all 17 B-4ec1 mutations report AT_UNKNOWN_REF regardless of their declared target/polarity; positive assertions merely copy IDs from a structurally clean matrix; transcript ordering is invented from producer/consumer array indexes rather than observed events. The current PASS artifact confirms all 17 rows are identical AT_UNKNOWN_REF. Thus F-009/F-012/F-015 remain semantically unresolved: current-story derivation removed the literal ID but still fabricates mutation bite, clean control, positive production execution, and transcript causality from topology structure. Execute each declared command/target and consume recorded outcomes/events, or fail closed when a mutation case lacks executable semantics; add mutations proving two different declared targets/codes and missing/reordered real events cannot be converted into identical structural proof.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed with actual assertion-site case ledger: the tracked runner executes production positive/mutation/transcript scenarios and canonical pre_review_check now PASSes with 21 evidence refs, 17 biting mutations, related transcript and admissible authority.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:140-166 and packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts:147-160,221-229 — executable authority is not bound to the executable that produced it and the advertised aggregate root is not verified. The sole accepted argv executes packages/main/dist/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.js, which is gitignored/unbound; the smoke itself overwrites that dist file with a proof emitter and demonstrates loadVerifiedPreReviewExecutableProof accepts it. The loader checks candidate.commandDigests only for sha256 syntax, never recomputes it from bindingProofs/case records, then wraps the caller value, stdout and receipt hash in a new digest. An owner can therefore replace the ignored dist runner, emit arbitrary matching bindingProofs plus any 64-hex aggregate, run the exact argv through live_smoke_transcript, and obtain the causal receipt that upgrades the claims to authority without changing storyFilesHash. Bind the executed module/build provenance to current tracked source and recompute the canonical case aggregate from a complete emitted case-record schema before accepting the receipt; add a malicious exact-argv dist replacement test that must fail rather than being the positive bounded-capture fixture.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed executable provenance: tracked runner performs a fresh build, binds runner and dist target digests, rejects overwritten dist, proves recovery, and current signed live transcript exited 0 with current provenance.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/pre-review-live-proof.ts:47 F-012 remains semantically unresolved: buildPreReviewLiveProof marks every positive assertion proven by copying its ID after a structural baseline; for every distinct mutation it performs the identical sourceRef-to-unknown edit (lines 51-61), and it fabricates transcript ordering from topology array indexes rather than observed producer/consumer events (lines 63-70). The case aggregate proves these synthetic records were not altered, not that the declared production commands ran or that each declared adverse mutation bit for its specified reason. Thus the current PASS can still label executableEvidence=current/mutations=biting/transcript=related without a real producer-to-consumer execution. Capture command/target/outcome/control/event receipts for each topology case and make the aggregate commit those observed results.

packages/main/src/core/acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:1329-1344 — F-013 producer-to-consumer relation is still file-wide for cross-file imports. importedCall succeeds when any callable in the declared consumer file calls the producer import; it is not scoped to consumer.expectedSymbolOrFact. A file can export a reachable consumeFact that returns an unrelated value, while a separate decoy function calls produceFact, and actualEndpointPathRefs will certify the planned producer→consumeFact relation. The current tests cover missing/type/dead/unreachable names but not this wrong-relation decoy. Resolve the imported binding within the AST body of the exact declared consumer callable (or a typed registered process-fact relation), and add a same-file decoy-caller mutation that must yield PR_PLANNED_PATH_UNRESOLVED before the direct consumeFact→produceFact control is restored.

packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:296 F-014 remains partially open: the closed static-call regex restricts the path kind but does not enforce canonical repo-relative paths; the shipped validator returns true for basis-path:path:static-call:../../evil.ts#p->consumer:/tmp/x.ts#c. PLAN forward admission therefore still accepts traversal/absolute nonexistent source refs before PRE_REVIEW rejects them. Reuse canonical path classification to reject absolute paths, dot segments, duplicate separators and non-normalized forms, and add these PLAN mutations.

packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts:28-33,162-177,221-233 and packages/main/src/core/pre-review-live-proof.ts:34-82 / packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:144-166 — canonical active-Story executable proof is still not the claimed end-to-end per-case proof. --live-proof exits immediately after buildActiveStoryPreReviewLiveProof; it does not execute the producer/read/lifecycle, planned-actual, artifact-tamper, cutoff, critic or restoration cases exercised later by the full smoke. Its 17 active mutation rows all perform the same mutation (replace each mutationCaseRef.sourceRef with unknown:* and call buildAcceptanceMatrixReport), so they do not execute the 17 different intent-declared mutations. The second non-B Story is only a direct buildPreReviewLiveProof unit call, not a live_smoke_transcript -> loader -> canonical pre_review_check roundtrip. The capture-cap case writes a preconstructed expandedProof fixture, and the aggregate-root tests only assert the digest helper changes; loadVerifiedPreReviewExecutableProof accepts an arbitrary syntactically valid candidate.commandDigests[0] because caseRecords are not emitted/recomputed. Thus current canonical PASS can still elevate unverified per-case claims. Execute the active Story cases represented by each mutation intent through the production consumer, emit/recompute verifier-bound case records (or individually signed outcome refs), prove aggregate-root tamper rejection through the loader, and run a second non-B Story through the real capture/loader/pre_review_check path before re-recording affected evidence.
